{"individuals": [
{"title": "Edit Check", "class": "product.softwarecapability", "quote": "Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing."},
{"title": "Reference check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "The first \"check\" the Editing Team will be introducing is one that will detect when people are attempting to add *new* content to an existing article *without* a corresponding reference and prompt them to do so."},
{"title": "Link check and Reference reliability", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Link check and Reference reliability**"},
{"title": "Paste Check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Paste Check**"},
{"title": "Tone check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "The Editing team works on new Checks:\n\n- **Tone check**"},
{"title": "Suggestion Mode", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March and at English Wikipedia since early February."},
{"title": "TextMatch", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Some communities have started to use the textMatch feature to create custom local types of Suggestion."},
{"title": "Multi-Check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours"},
{"title": "Add an image suggestion type", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "A new experimental suggestion type, \"Add an image\", has been created using the same functionality as the Growth team's version."},
{"title": "Add a link suggestion type", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Work is also ongoing on improving the functionality of the \"Add a link\" suggestion type, so that it can become a default global suggestion type in the future."},
{"title": "addReference suggestions", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Better detection of existing references for the `addReference` suggestions"},
{"title": "ignoreQuotedContent setting", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Better detection of quotations for the `ignoreQuotedContent` setting"},
{"title": "Hide suggestions toggle-button", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Addition of a toggle-button to hide suggestions temporarily - this will soon also save the 'hidden' state across future edit-sessions"},
{"title": "Special:EditChecks", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Clearer and more accurate details in `Special:EditChecks` which shows the local configuration"},
{"title": "Edit-tags on published edits", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Two new edit-tags added to published edits"},
{"title": "Desktop siderail", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new \"siderail.\""},
{"title": "Edit Check configurability", "class": "product.softwarecapability", "quote": "The functionality will be accompanied by a complimentary set of features that will enable moderators to configure the user experience newcomers and Junior Contributors will see"},
{"title": "Audit and edit activation logic", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Audit** and **edit** the logic that determines when the reference Edit Check becomes activated"},
{"title": "Review edits shown Edit Check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Review** the edits people who are shown Edit Check are making"},
{"title": "Mobile visual editor publishing workflow", "class": "product.userworkflow", "quote": "The first version of Edit Check will introduce a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow"},
{"title": "Edit Check step in mobile publishing", "class": "product.workflowstep", "quote": "a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow that people will see if/when they add new content *without* a reference."},
{"title": "Visual editor", "class": "application.applicationcomponent", "quote": "the Editing Team will be introducing new functionality within the visual editor (desktop and mobile)"},
{"title": "editcheck/init.js", "class": "technology.artifact", "quote": "The conditions above are implemented and maintained in code here: editcheck/init.js"},
{"title": "Editing Team", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor to help new volunteers understand and follow some of the policies and guidelines"},
{"title": "Wikimedia Foundation Product Department", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "why the Wikimedia Foundation's Product Department is prioritizing this work."},
{"title": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors", "class": "product.persona", "quote": "Experience: **Learning the basics of contributing to Wikipedia**"},
{"title": "Inexperienced volunteers", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "**Inexperienced volunteers** – become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone"},
{"title": "Experienced volunteers/moderators", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "**Experienced volunteers/moderators** – need to do more work reverting low-quality edits"},
{"title": "Wikipedia projects", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "**Wikipedia projects** – struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations"},
{"title": "Administrators at all Wikipedias", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "Administrators at all Wikipedias can help to configure this tool so that it can recognize local standard heading-names"},
{"title": "Definition of learning the basics", "class": "motivation.meaning", "quote": "we are considering people who are still \"learning the basics\" to be people who have published <100 cumulative edits to a single, or multiple, Wikipedias."},
{"title": "Newcomers feel safe and confident publishing", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful."},
{"title": "Moderators notice quality and configure Edit Check", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them."},
{"title": "Offer actionable policy feedback while editing", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Offering inexperienced volunteers relevant and actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies in the precious moments when they are in the midst of making a change using the visual editor."},
{"title": "Equip moderators to specify feedback", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Equipping moderators with a new ability to specify the feedback inexperienced volunteers are presented with while they are editing"},
{"title": "Editing interfaces don't surface policies", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow."},
{"title": "Visual editor succeeds at teaching technical skills", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "the editing experience has been reasonably successful at helping inexperienced volunteers learn the *technical skills* necessary to publish changes to Wikipedia."},
{"title": "Newcomers' edits often break best practices", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "the changes inexperienced volunteers publish often break established best practices and lead to undesirable outcomes"},
{"title": "Reverts demotivate inexperienced volunteers", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "These poor interactions are demotivating and drive these could-be volunteers and community members, and the knowledge that are uniquely positioned to offer, away."},
{"title": "Moderators burdened by low-quality edits", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "Continually needing to educate inexperienced volunteers and undo their changes can lead to experienced volunteers becoming skeptical of inexperienced volunteers and impatient with them."},
{"title": "Projects struggle to grow and diversify", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations and shrink the knowledge gaps present within Wikimedia wikis."},
{"title": "Newcomers twice as likely in Africa or Asia", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Newcomers are two times more likely to live in Africa or Asia."},
{"title": "Retention struggle outside Europe and North America", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "The movement struggles to retain editors who live outside Europe and North America."},
{"title": "Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresented among editors", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors, despite representing 15% of the global population and 7% of the global internet population."},
{"title": "80% of SSA editors edit English or French", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "80% of registered editors in Sub-Saharan Africa contribute to English or French Wikipedia."},
{"title": "Surfacing guidance leads to valued edits", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "by surfacing relevant guidance in the precious moments when inexperienced volunteers are in the midst of making a change to Wikipedia and equipping them with the know-how and tools necessary to apply this guidance, they will make changes they are proud of"},
{"title": "Make norms legible and actionable while editing", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "we first need to make the norms and standards that are currently in place legible and actionable to people while they are editing."},
{"title": "Moderators must be empowered to configure Edit Check", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "The Editing Team thinks it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated."},
{"title": "Minimize false positives, evolve heuristic per project", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "pursuing an approach with Edit Check that minimizes the likelihood of false positives and is implemented in ways that empower volunteers, on a per-project basis, to evolve the heuristic to become more robust over time."},
{"title": "Reference check activation conditions", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing"},
{"title": "New paragraph lacks a reference", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "The \"new paragraph(s) of text\" someone has added does NOT include a reference"},
{"title": "Only in main namespace", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "The changes described in \"1.\" and \"2.\" are happening on a page within the main namespace (NS:0)"},
{"title": "Guidance intuitive so newcomers return", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors find the guidance Edit Check is presenting them with, and the editing experience more broadly, to be intuitive and straightforward so that they feel encourage to return to edit again"},
{"title": "Avoid creating work for experienced volunteers", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Decrease the likelihood that Edit Check is creating more work for experienced volunteers by prompting newcomers and Junior Contributors to add sources when they are not needed"},
{"title": "Store suggestions more efficiently", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "The team is building a way for Suggestions to be stored more efficiently, so that in the future the suggestions can be used by, or shown within, other software features"},
{"title": "A/B experiment measures newcomer impact", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "to measure what kind of impact the tool has on the percentage of constructive (un-reverted) edits by newcomers, as well as editor-retention and any changes in revert-rates and block rates."},
{"title": "LLMs effective at checking web sources in English", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "This research confirmed that in English LLMs are effective at evaluating whether web-based sources corroborate claims on Wikipedia."},
{"title": "Project start", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "Start: | 2022-10-01"},
{"title": "Suggestion Mode Beta release", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March and at English Wikipedia since early February."},
{"title": "Suggestion Mode A/B experiment launch", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "The A/B experiment was launched on 15 wikis and is collecting data."},
{"title": "Siderail design release December 2024", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "In December 2024, we released a new design for the Edit Check desktop experience."},
{"title": "Multi-Check deployment June 25, 2025", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025."},
{"title": "Multi-Check (References) A/B Test", "class": "business.businessprocess", "quote": "To learn whether the Multi-Check was effective at causing, newcomers to publish new content edits that include references while lowering the likelihood those edits would be reverted, we ran an A/B test with 12 Wikipedias."},
{"title": "Multi-Check Phase 1 Impact Analysis", "class": "business.businessprocess", "quote": "To decide how – if at all – this change impacted volunteer disruption and edit quality, we compared analyzed several key metrics shifted before and after this change."},
{"title": "Reference Check A/B Test", "class": "business.businessprocess", "quote": "To learn whether the Reference Edit Check is effective at causing **newcomers to make edits they intended and experienced volunteers value**, we conducted an A/B test with 15 Wikipedias."},
{"title": "Multi-Check increased referenced unreverted edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours without causing undesirable changes in edit completion or other forms of disruption (e.g. blocks)."},
{"title": "Multiple checks 1.3x more likely to add reference", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Edits that were shown multiple Reference Checks in a session are **1.3 times** more likely to include at least one new reference in the final published edit"},
{"title": "No significant overall revert rate change (Multi-Check)", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Overall, we did not identify any significant changes in new content edit revert rate between the control and test group."},
{"title": "34.7% revert decrease with multiple checks", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "there was a **-34.7% decrease** in revert rate when directly comparing edits presented multiple checks compared to edits presented a single reference check"},
{"title": "5.5% increase in users publishing referenced edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "there was a **5.5% increase** in the proportion of distinct users who published a new content edit with a reference when multi-check was available."},
{"title": "No completion decrease up to 5 checks", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "There were **no decreases** in edit completion rate for up to 5 reference checks being presented in a single session"},
{"title": "Multiple checks shown at 19% of edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "multiple reference checks were shown within a single editing session at **19% of all published new content VE edits (549 edits)** by unregistered users and users with 100 or fewer edits."},
{"title": "Multi-check completion rate 76.1% vs 75%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The edit completion rate for sessions that were shown multiple checks within a session was **76.1% compared to 75%** for sessions shown only one check"},
{"title": "52.5% vs 39.7% included a reference", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "In the test group, **52.5%** of all published edits shown multiple Reference checks included at least one new reference compared to **39.7%** of edits that were shown a single check."},
{"title": "Multi-check revert rate 17% vs 26%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "the revert rate of new content edits shown multiple Reference Checks (**17%**) is currently lower compared to sessions shown a single Reference Check (**26%**)."},
{"title": "Siderail: revert rate decreased 15.7%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The revert rate of new content edits where Reference Check was activated decreased by **15.7%**."},
{"title": "Siderail: referenced edits increased 8%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The proportion of new content edits that included a reference following the change increased **8%**."},
{"title": "Siderail: 3.2% completion rate increase", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Excluding reverted edits, there was **3.2%** increase [2 percentage points] in edit completion rate."},
{"title": "Siderail: decline rate decreased 4.7%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The rate at which people *declined* to add a reference when Edit Check prompted them decreased **4.7%.**"},
{"title": "Siderail design net positive", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "The findings above suggest this design change has been net positive."},
{"title": "Continue using siderail design paradigm", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "we will continue depending on this new design paradigm as we introduce new types of Edit Checks and moments within the editing workflow when they are presented."},
{"title": "Reference Check increased edit quality without disruption", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**."},
{"title": "Reference Check default-on would be net positive", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "offering Reference Check as a default-on feature would have a net positive impact on all wikis and the people who contribute to them."},
{"title": "2.2x more likely constructive referenced edit", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "People shown the Reference Check are **2.2 times more likely** to publish a new content edit that includes a reference and is constructive (not reverted within 48 hours)."},
{"title": "4.2x more likely on mobile", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The highest observed increase was on mobile where contributors are **4.2 times more likely** to publish a constructive new content edit with a reference"},
{"title": "Revert rate decreased 8.6%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "New content edit revert rate **decreased by 8.6%** if Reference Check was available."},
{"title": "SSA edits 53% less likely reverted", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "New content edits by contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa are **53% less likely** to be reverted when Reference Check is shown to eligible edits."},
{"title": "16% more likely to return in second month", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Contributors that are shown Reference Check and successfully save a non-reverted edit are **16 percent more likely** to return to make a non-reverted edit in their second month (31-60 days after)."},
{"title": "10% decrease in edit completion rate", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Overall, there was a **10% decrease** in edit completion rate for edits where Reference Check was shown."},
{"title": "Completion decrease higher on mobile", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "On mobile, edit completion rate decreased by -24.3% while on desktop it decreased by -3.1%."},
{"title": "Block rate decreased or unchanged", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "There were **decreases or no changes** in the rate of users blocked after after being shown Reference Check and publishing an edit compared to users in the control group."},
{"title": "Low false negative rate 1.8%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Only **1.8%** of all published new content edits in the test group did not include a new reference and were not shown Reference Check."},
{"title": "False positive rate 6.6%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "**6.6%** of contributors dismissed adding a citation because they indicated the new content being added does not need a reference."},
{"title": "Increase quality of SSA newcomer edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace"},
{"title": "Increase likelihood of adding references", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will accompany the new content they are adding with a reference"},
{"title": "Newcomers report feeling safe and confident", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will report feeling safe and confident making changes to Wikipedia"},
{"title": "Experienced volunteers audit default configurations", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Experienced volunteers will independently audit and iterate upon Edit Check's default configurations to ensure Edit Check is causing newcomers and Junior Contributors to make productive edits."},
{"title": "Newcomers more aware of need for references", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors will be more aware of the need to add a reference when contributing new content because the visual editor will prompt them to do so"},
{"title": "Risk: edit quality decreases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit quality decreases"},
{"title": "Risk: unreliable citations harder to patrol", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edits become more difficult to patrol because unreliable citations are difficult to detect"},
{"title": "Risk: edit completion rate drastically decreases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit completion rate drastically decreases"},
{"title": "Risk: edit abandonment rate drastically increases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit abandonment rate drastically increases"},
{"title": "Risk: blocks increase", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Blocks increase"},
{"title": "Risk: high false positive or negative rates", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "High false positive or false negative rates"},
{"title": "Risk: Edit Check too resource intensive", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale"}
]}
